verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm multimodal input: reasoning models 'accept text and image inputs' (gpt-docs-23), and the changelog documents flagship models supporting 'image input' alongside a 1M token context (gpt-supp-capability-flags), plus image generation/editing endpoints (gpt-docs-28). Audio/voice is covered via realtime/WebRTC voice guides (gpt-docs-11, gpt-docs-30), and file/document input is referenced via 'file search' tools (gpt-docs-29, gpt-docs-19). missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc enumerating document-upload (PDF) input formats or file size/type limits, and no independent hands-on confirmation of multimodal input in this evidence pack (one old community comment even reports visual input being unavailable at an earlier GPT-4 stage, gpt-comm-12).
